Hi! I'm deciding between a few options and money's a bit tight, can you help me choose?
Absolutely, I’d be glad to help you narrow things down, especially if you’re watching your budget.
To make the best recommendation, can you tell me a few things:
What are you deciding between?
Specific rose varieties, perennials, bulbs, or a mix?
If you have names, feel free to list them and I can help you compare.
Your garden details
ZIP code or hardiness zone (so I don’t suggest anything that will struggle)
How much sun the spot gets (full sun = 6+ hours, partial shade = around 4 hours)
Your priorities
What matters most: strong fragrance, continuous blooms, low maintenance, cutting flowers for vases, or something else?
Are you hoping for one really special plant, or to spread your budget over several plants?
A rough budget
For example: “I can spend about $X total.” That helps me suggest the best value.
Also, just so you know, right now we have our Fall Planting Sale from August 13, 2026 through August 17, 2026 with $10 or $20 off all roses, automatically at checkout. That can stretch your dollars a bit if you’re leaning toward roses.
If you send me the names of the options you’re considering plus your zone/ZIP, I can give you a simple “if it were my garden on a budget, I’d pick ___ because…” comparison.
